register_mcss_math_directive: register the math directive and role with docutils RST parser using mcss settings and hooks
render_math_block: render a block math directive to SVG using latex2svg and wrap in an m-math container
render_inline_math: render an inline math role to SVG and return a raw docutils node with classes
save_math_cache: save the latex2svg rendering cache to a pickle file at the configured M_MATH_CACHE_FILE path
reset_math_counter: reset the latex2svg extra counter to zero at the start of a new page
